code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}signers`;const getSigners=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};const deleteSigner=async(signerId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+signerId,config);return response.data;};const updateSigner=async(signerId,signerData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+signerId,signerData,config);return response.data;};const createSigner=async(signerData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,signerData,config);return response.data;};const signerService={createSigner,getSigners,deleteSigner,updateSigner};export default signerService;
